question: Which of the following is true about the original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court of India?

options.text: It reviews the decisions of tribunals
It settles disputes between the Union and states
It deals with criminal appeals only

solution:
The correct answer is __**It settles disputes between the Union and states**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **original jurisdiction** of the Supreme Court of India is outlined in **Article 131** of the Constitution of India.
 
• Under this jurisdiction, the Supreme Court has the authority to settle disputes between:
 
 
• The Government of India and one or more states.
 
• The Government of India and any state(s) on one side and one or more states on the other side.
 
• Two or more states.
